featured.title: Europe Battles Historic Wildfires
featured.content: Firefighters from several European countries continue battling major wildfires across southwestern France and parts of Spain. Authorities have evacuated hundreds of thousands of residents as extreme temperatures and strong winds continue to fuel the blazes near Bordeaux and other affected regions. 0
